summary: Implemented agent finish support for recorded worktrees: branch/head/dirty checks now run against reservation.git.worktreePath, closeout stamps the worktree head, Git finish evidence probes the worktree, and --remove-worktree prunes after successful close.
command: COREPACK_HOME=/private/tmp/corepack pnpm check && COREPACK_HOME=/private/tmp/corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/git-worktree-lifecycle.test.ts tests/runtime/git-branch-lifecycle.test.ts && COREPACK_HOME=/private/tmp/corepack pnpm test && git diff --check
